incident-bot: P1 alert: post-release wavepack rollout in us-west-2 -> 95p latency spike on runtime path. Auto-paging to #incidents. Affected routes: /v1/generate (text), /v1/embed (embeddings).
ash_oncall: ack — pulling dashboards + logs. tagging eng-runtime.
kim_runtime: seeing kernel selector path fall back to legacy-quant kernel for ~18-24% of requests on canary hosts. 95p from ~220ms -> ~980ms. looks correlated with rollout timestamp.
mike_sre: is this eviction/prefetch thrash or bad kernel selection? any CPU/GPU saturation?
kim_runtime: GPU utilization steady. KV cache miss rate up on the canary slice; batching backlog grows -> tails. logs show: 
```
2026-03-17T18:07:02Z runtime: selector -> kernel=legacy-quant (fallback) latency=942ms req_id=xyz
2026-03-17T18:07:03Z batching: queue_depth=112 batch_ms=85
```
jen_devops: advised: pause rollout and flip feature flag for selector. I can flip `selector_wavepack` to off. Confirm?
ash_oncall: yes please pause. also rate-limit the canary route at the ingress layer to 30rps while we assess.
deploy-bot: rollout paused for release/wavepack @ 3055554200. feature flag `selector_wavepack` is currently ON. awaiting flip command.
jen_devops: running: `deployctl featureflag set selector_wavepack false --env us-west-2 --by oncall`
jen_devops: ✅ feature flag toggled. deploy-bot: `featureflag selector_wavepack=false` recorded by jen_devops at 3055554899.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic reduced by 90% (divert -> stable).
kim_runtime: after flag flip kernel selection reverted to canonical kernel; tail latency trending down but batching backlog still clearing (~10m expected). Observed a small uptick in inference 5xx on affected canaries during the spike.
raj_support: customer impact snapshot: 4 paid customers reported degraded UX (chat slowdown), total affected request volume ~2.8% of global traffic. Error rate delta +2.9% during 18:06-18:18 window. no data exfiltration.
lara_pm: escalate comms: notify account owners for the 4 customers and Sales SEs. Prepare a postmortem note template.
mike_sre: next steps: (1) keep rollout paused; (2) keep selector_wavepack off in us-west-2; (3) run a controlled canary with instrumentation to validate kernel mapping; (4) consider rollback of release artifact if we see repeated fallback. Agreed?
kim_runtime: agree. I want to capture the kernel selector decision tree snapshot and a small reproduce test. suspect an ordering bug where a fallback threshold is too aggressive when batch_ms > 60ms.
ash_oncall: handing off to night on-call sam_oncall for monitoring and follow-up. Sam, please watch 95/99p and batching queue depth for next 3h.
sam_oncall: ack — will monitor, escalate if >2x baseline or >5% error.
jen_devops: starting a rollback runbook dry-run in staging; if we need to rollback we do: `deployctl rollback release/wavepack --region us-west-2` (requires 2 approvers).
kim_runtime: logging attachment: kernel-selection diffs + sample request ids (will post to incident doc).
ash_oncall: tagging docs: incident create -> draft with timeline. Assigning follow-up: kim_runtime (root cause analysis), jen_devops (rollback/runbook), mike_sre (mitigation checklist), lara_pm (customer comms), raj_support (customer callbacks).
lara_pm: schedule postmortem tomorrow 11:00 PT. notify attendees.
nash_oncall: closing active pager for now — mitigation in place (flag off + traffic divert). Will update incident doc when RCA artifacts are in. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. severity: P1 -> active -> mitigated. reference: 3055554321
